repos.name: earendil-works/pi
repos.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive AI agent toolkit providing a unified LLM API, agent loop, and coding-agent CLI.
bullets: Built with TypeScript for cross-platform compatibility.
Features a unified LLM abstraction layer to switch between providers seamlessly.
Includes a built-in TUI and CLI for managing autonomous agent workflows.
Designed for developers building complex, multi-step agentic applications.

repos.name: lexmount/moli
repos.description: Best browser for AI Agent, written in pure Rust
repos.one_liner: A high-performance browser built in pure Rust specifically optimized for AI agent interaction.
bullets: Developed in Rust to ensure memory safety and high-speed execution.
Architected specifically to handle the unique requirements of headless AI agent browsing.
Provides a low-latency interface for agents to navigate and interact with modern web DOMs.
Ideal for automation tasks requiring high-throughput web scraping or agentic navigation.

repos.name: deepopen-com/deepopen
repos.description: 非自回归System 1决策引擎，专为结构化类型决策场景设计  DeepOpen Multilingual, non-autoregressive System 1 decision engine.
repos.one_liner: A non-autoregressive System 1 decision engine designed for high-speed, structured decision-making.
bullets: Utilizes a non-autoregressive architecture to bypass traditional LLM latency bottlenecks.
Optimized for structured data processing and deterministic decision-making tasks.
Acts as a specialized inference engine for high-frequency or real-time AI logic.
Suitable for fintech or quant applications where low-latency decision logic is critical.

repos.name: ThinkWatchProject/ThinkWatch-Lite
repos.description: Local gateway for Claude Code, Codex and other AI clients on macOS, Windows and Linux: switch upstreams without touching clients, keep API keys from relays, cut off malicious tool calls, trace every request.
repos.one_liner: A local gateway for AI clients that provides security, API key management, and request tracing.
bullets: Acts as a middleware proxy for Claude Code, Codex, and other LLM clients.
Enables centralized API key management and upstream provider switching.
Includes security features to intercept and block malicious tool calls.
Provides observability through detailed request tracing and logging.

repos.name: Vibra-Ingenn/Janus
repos.description: Janus is a API router for AI models written in Go and has a Vulkan Model runner
repos.one_liner: A high-performance API router for AI models written in Go with a Vulkan-based model runner.
bullets: Written in Go for efficient concurrency and low-overhead request routing.
Integrates a Vulkan-based model runner for hardware-accelerated local inference.
Designed to serve as a lightweight infrastructure layer for deploying multiple AI models.
Useful for edge-computing scenarios requiring local model execution and API orchestration.
